digest.component_or_area: maintenance audit runbook and rebar-janitor workflow integration
propositions: The maintenance audit runbook embeds dated tool inventory, machine state, and capture debris that should be removed and replaced with references to durable artifacts like session logs and tickets
The module limit is described as a soft cap in the runbook but should be stated as an absolute CI gate sourced from .github/module-size-limit.txt
The audit runbook should delegate audit phases to the packaged rebar-janitor skill via a project adapter pattern while retaining project-specific gate commands and their required inputs
The runbook must remove dated observations and incident narratives, replacing them with historical ticket references for context
Documentation read-only commands and link checks must pass after the runbook rewrite to maintain documentation contract compliance
